name: Simeon and Anna
charge: Just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel; a widow who departed not from the temple, serving God with fastings and prayers night and day
summary: An old man had been told by the Holy Ghost that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ. He came by the Spirit into the temple the day a poor couple brought a forty-day-old child with a pair of turtledoves, took him in his arms, and asked to be let go in peace. A prophetess of eighty-four who had lived in the temple since her husband died came in that same hour and spoke of him to all that looked for redemption.
offense: Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him. He came by the Spirit into the temple. Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity; and she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
judgment: It was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ. Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said, Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word: for mine eyes have seen thy salvation, which thou hast prepared before the face of all people; a light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel. And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem. Two who kept the law past the end of their strength were the first in the temple to know whom they had been waiting for.

entries.commentary: A decree from Caesar Augustus sends every man to his own city to be taxed, and Joseph goes up to Bethlehem because he was of the house and lineage of David. She brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.

The angel gives the shepherds a sign: ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger. The swaddling clothes are the mark of an ordinary entrance into life. The wise man says plainly that there is no king that had any other beginning of birth.
The shepherds come with haste, find Mary and Joseph and the babe, and make known abroad what was told them concerning this child. Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
When eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called Jesus. He was born under the law and everything done for him was done after the law.
When the days of her purification were accomplished they brought him to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord, and to offer a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons, as it is written in the law.

Simeon was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and it was revealed unto him that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ. Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel, and for a sign which shall be spoken against.

Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser, departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day. She is named by her tribe. Asher was still there in that day, and she spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover, and at twelve years old he tarried behind, and was found in the temple sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them and asking them questions. Wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business? They understood not the saying. He went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them. He was raised under his parents and under the law, and increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God. The word is to speak comfortably to Jerusalem and cry that her warfare is accomplished and her iniquity pardoned, for she has received of the Lord's hand double for all her sins. The voice crying in the wilderness to prepare the way of the Lord goes into the prophecy of John, the spirit of Elijah, with every valley exalted, every mountain and hill made low, and the crooked made straight so the glory of the Lord shall be revealed and all flesh shall see it together. All flesh is grass and its goodliness as the flower of the field; the grass withers and the flower fades, but the word of our God stands forever. It compares our lives to the flowers of the field: we are born, we grow, we die, and go back into the ground, but the word of the Most High is forever. -

Zion is told to get up to the high mountain and lift up her voice with strength, not afraid, to say to the cities of Judah, Behold your God. The Lord God will come with a strong hand, his arm ruling for him, his reward with him and his work before him. He shall feed his flock like a shepherd, gather the lambs with his arm and carry them in his bosom, and gently lead those that are with young.

The Most High measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, meted out heaven with a span, and weighed the mountains in scales. No one directed his Spirit or taught him counsel, judgment, knowledge, or the way of understanding. All nations are as a drop of a bucket and counted as the small dust of the balance. Lebanon is not sufficient to burn nor its beasts sufficient for the offering; all nations before him are as nothing, counted less than nothing and vanity. -

To whom then will you liken God, or what likeness compare to him? The workman melts a graven image, the goldsmith spreads it with gold and casts silver chains. He that is too poor for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot and seeks a skilled workman to prepare a graven image that will not be moved. Seeking a tree is the spirit of Nimrod that our people worshipped back then; instead of the tree itself, he made a graven image of the tree.

Have you not known, have you not heard from the beginning? It is he that sits upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants are as grasshoppers; he stretches out the heavens as a curtain and spreads them as a tent to dwell in. The circle of the earth is the two-dimensional shape of a sphere. He brings the princes to nothing and makes the judges of the earth as vanity; they are not planted or sown before he blows upon them and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble. Lift up your eyes on high and behold who created these things, bringing out their host by number and calling them all by name; by the greatness of his might, not one fails.

Why does Jacob say his way is hid from the Lord and his judgment passed over from his God? The everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth, faints not, is not weary, and there is no searching of his understanding. He gives power to the faint and increases strength to them that have no might. Even the youths faint and the young men utterly fall, but they that wait upon the Lord renew their strength. This goes into Israel receiving the kingdom and the power of the Lord. Everybody may get weary and faint, but the Lord does not, and those that trust in him mount up with wings as eagles, run and are not weary, walk and do not faint.

verses.text: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
(Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the Lord of hosts.
